    // The vector rotated counter-clockwise by the given angle.
    RotateBy(v: Vector2D, angle: Angle): Vector2D
        => (v.X * angle.Cos - v.Y * angle.Sin,
                    v.X * angle.Sin + v.Y * angle.Cos);
